[[Image:AlienStatue.png|right|160px]]
'''Alien Statue''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Movement''': Exhaust and spend 2 [[movement]] points and 1 [[Sanity]] to roll a die.  If the die is a success, draw 1 [[Spell]] or gain 3 [[Clue token]]s.  If it is a failure, lose 2 [[Stamina]].

'''Price''': $5
